title: Review request deadlines are timers; open requests are read by index
description:
Today a soft review's deadline is checked only when someone reads the list (`expire_due` runs on every read), and every read lists the whole `ReviewRequest` table, as does every gated publish. Give `ReviewRequest` a sparse `dueAt` and an index on state and time; set a follow-up timer for a soft review's deadline, so 'proceeded without review' happens at the deadline with nobody looking; read open requests by index everywhere (`list_reviews`, the publish gate, recipients). A flag and a hard gate still have no deadline.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A soft review proceeds at its deadline with no page open.
- The Notification Center and the publish gate read open requests by index.
- No code path lists the whole `ReviewRequest` table.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- review-deadline-timers.feature: a soft review times out at its deadline unattended; an answer before the deadline cancels the timer; a hard gate never times out; the publish gate finds its request by index.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Amplify data schema: one GSI on `ReviewRequest` (its own release).

**Part of:** Timers: the schedule trigger and follow-ups. Slice code C3 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Proved live on MoM 2026-11-23: soft review rr-timer-live-check-20261123 raised 04:02:37Z with a 04:05:32Z deadline; follow-up timer follow-up-d3e600cd… fired through the wakes queue and the review_deadline wake marked it timed_out ('proceeded without review', by system) at 04:06:48Z with no page open. Open requests are read by the state index; the only whole-table read left is the one-time reviews:index-backfill. Spec: features_backend/stories/review-deadline-timers.feature.
